name: optcg-companion
description: Real-time OPTCG Simulator companion HUD overlay

scripts.dev: OPTCG_SOURCE=mock concurrently -k -n tauri,stream -c blue,green "npm run dev:tauri" "npm run dev:stream"
scripts.build: cd browser-companion && npm run build && cd ../src-ui && npm run build
scripts.build:tauri: cd src-ui && npm run tauri build
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd src-ui && npm install
